sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: Concentration provides no benefit by itself. It maintains the ongoing spell effect that established it.

sections.label: REPLACEMENT
sections.html: Beginning a new Concentration ends the spell effect maintained by your previous Concentration.

sections.label: BREAK
sections.html: Suffering a Core Wound breaks Concentration. Temporary Wounds do not break it unless an effect specifically says otherwise.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
